mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates and increases the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals strong economic demand, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300, the 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.5%, the 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310) signals persistent inflation, leading to prolonged monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0% AND CPIAUCSL > 310, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a demand-driven expansion (HOUST > 1300 and INDPRO > 100), the economy is overheating, increasing the probability of monetary policy tightening, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1300 AND INDPRO > 100, the 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an economic slowdown, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) compresses corporate earnings growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE >= 4.0%, the 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of slowing employment growth (PAYEMS < 158000) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS < 158000 AND INDPRO < 100, the 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
